item.title: Poland’s Name Appears in U.S. F-15EX Deal, Warsaw Denies Procurement Plans
item.summary: Warsaw says it doesn't have F-15EX procurement plans for now, but an AH-64 Apache precedent makes the development intriguing. The post Poland’s Name Appears in U.S. F-15EX Deal, Warsaw Denies Procurement Plans appeared first on TWZ .
